text:
isabel: heads-up: I hit a weird shutdown/cleanup mismatch in the Go SDK generator while iterating with a short deadline. Repro is small.

dan: paste repro + logs?

isabel: gist: using the pull iterator (Next(ctx)/Token()), when auth refresh overlaps with a ctx cancel the Next call returns but a background retry goroutine keeps running and repeatedly logs refresh attempts. Expected everything to stop when ctx cancels.

mike: which auth path? lazy refresh in middleware?

isabel: yes, our token refresher does a goroutine + retry backoff to avoid blocking the transport. That goroutine doesn't accept the request ctx so it keeps retrying after cancel.

tara: can you share minimal snippet?

isabel: simplified:

```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 900*time.Millisecond)
iter, _ := client.Generator(ctx, req)
for iter.Next(ctx) {
  _ = iter.Token()
}
if err := iter.Err(); err != nil {
  log.Println("iter err:", err)
}
```

isabel: logs:
```
2025-06-02T11:02:10Z auth: refresh start
2025-06-02T11:02:10Z transport: got 401, retrying
2025-06-02T11:02:11Z ctx deadline exceeded
2025-06-02T11:02:12Z auth: refresh start
2025-06-02T11:02:13Z auth: refresh start
```

mike: root cause: retry goroutine not cancellation-aware + iterator has no explicit Close hook. Two fixes: make auth refresher accept ctx; add Close() on iterator so callers can force-stop.

d an: (sic) prefer add Close() first since non-breaking and lets us update sampleapp quickly. Also audit middleware for detached goroutines.

tara: agree. DX change: update sampleapp quickstart to call `defer iter.Close()` and document the pattern. Also add a unit test injecting a slow auth double that cancels mid-refresh and asserts no lingering refresh after a small grace window.

isabel: local workaround: pass a child cancellable ctx specifically for the iterator and cancel it explicitly on exit. Ugly but works: `opCtx, stop := context.WithCancel(ctx); iter, _ := client.Generator(opCtx, req); defer stop()`

mike: dev plan: (1) prototype iter.Close() implementing io.Closer, idempotent and waits for worker shutdown; (2) update sampleapp + quickstart; (3) audit and make auth refresher ctx-aware in a follow-up.

ci-bot: created issue #3044 "go-sdk: iterator Close() and auth refresh cancellation" assigned to @mike.

d an: thanks for the clear repro, isabel. Will help with a unit test and the sampleapp patch.

tara: adding an FAQ note "Why does my generator keep running after ctx cancel?" linking to the sampleapp and Close() docs would help users.

mike: will include a small migration note in the changelog.

isabel: happy to open the small sampleapp PR demonstrating defer iter.Close() and a flaky-resistant test.

ci-bot: closing triage; labeling as p2 and DX-improvement.
